set.request: the devbar needs to get farther off screen, the resize handle appears and hijacks user input
steps: Reproduce and measure the overhang in the live tab
Push the closed transform past the grip in devbar.css
Verify closed: nothing on screen, right-edge clicks reach the page
Verify open: slide, hover pill and drag-resize still work
Refresh the doc set for anything gone stale
set.outcome: **The closed dev rail is fully off screen.** `.dev-bar` hid with `translateX(100%)` — its own width — but `.dev-grip` is centred on that edge, so half of it hung outside the box the percentage measures and landed back on the page: a 15px invisible `ew-resize` column down the full height of EVERY page, which `setPointerCapture` turned from a wrong cursor into a swallowed gesture. Fix is three lines: `--dev-grip: 2rem` joins `--dev-rail` on `:root`, the hide slides `calc(100% + var(--dev-grip))`, and grip.css consumes the token so the two files cannot drift again. Verified at 3440: 0px on screen with 17px clearance, right-edge clicks reach page content, no overflow — and open/slide/hover-pill/drag-resize all still work. Docs updated: doc/file/devbar.css.md, doc/file/grip.css.md, doc/docking.md, and the readme's 'No handle when closed' decision, which this bug had been quietly violating since the rail shipped.
